intro: The Gambia's economy depends on farming, tourism and money from abroad.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Peanuts are the main crop. Beach and birdwatching tourism draws visitors from Europe. Money sent home by Gambians abroad is a big share of the economy.

chapters.title: Fish
text: Fishing is important, though fishmeal factories have caused concern.

cardGroups.title: Made in the Gambia
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things the Gambia makes and sells to the world.
